description:
An open-source, local-first AI desktop app that directs specialist sub-agents and runs your installed coding CLIs.

Orkas is an open-source, local-first AI desktop app. A commander LLM directs specialist sub-agents and runs your installed coding CLIs, such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, as local sessions. Agents self-evolve via reflection and skill crystallization, and you bring your own keys.

Download
Download Orkas
Highlights
- Create and recover work in the Content workbench and product listing apps, with configured media services and Orkas·Voice speech labels.
- Build, preview and revise video timelines with clearer reference handling, playback controls and delivery feedback.
- Work with layered images, RAW photos, PDFs and Office documents through improved inspection, editing and export tools.
- Review known responsiveness, context-size, shutdown and document-recovery limitations in the release review.
Improvements
- Use more configured speech providers and audio workflows, with better media transfer and rate-limit recovery.
- Keep conversations, project drafts, local tasks and automation state consistent through delayed responses and restarts.
- Reuse provider caches across sessions and receive reminders to use collected search evidence during long research runs.
Fixes
- Preserve local files, task outputs and browser media through interrupted work, and improve diagnostics without exposing credentials.
